Trigger An ally within 30 feet fails a Will save

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. The triggering ally is unaffected by that effect, and you suffer it instead, using the ally's degree of failure — you do not attempt your own save. If the effect could not affect you at all, the Bandwidth is still spent and the ally is still unaffected.
